It contained<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Ichalin Station]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|76|Ichalin Station}}</ref>
